languages: Giant Eagle, understands Common and Auran but can't speak

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

multiattack_text: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

attacks.name: Beak
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

attacks.name: Talons
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
